title: sazardev/shiki
claim: sazardev/shiki — TUI note-taking app in Rust — Yazi-style navigation, notebooks as independent git repos, real per-note version history,
why_good: Shiki is a terminal-based note-taking app that uses a three-pane Yazi-style navigation, allowing users to manage notebooks as independent git repositories. It features real per-note version history, fast fuzzy search, and customizable themes.
value: Developers and power users pay for Shiki to maintain detailed version histories of their notes and leverage git's capabilities for organization and retrieval.
risk: Shiki may struggle against established note-taking apps like Notion or Obsidian, which have larger user bases and extensive feature sets.

zh.claim: 通过 Shiki 改变您的笔记记录：一个跟踪每个变化的 TUI 应用，支持独立的 git 仓库。
zh.why_good: Shiki 是一个基于终端的笔记记录应用，采用三窗格 Yazi 风格导航，允许用户将笔记本管理为独立的 git 仓库。它具有真实的每笔记版本历史、快速模糊搜索和可定制主题。
zh.value: 开发者和高级用户为 Shiki 付费，以维护其笔记的详细版本历史，并利用 git 的能力进行组织和检索。
zh.risk: Shiki 可能会面临来自 Notion 或 Obsidian 等成熟笔记记录应用的竞争，这些应用拥有更大的用户基础和广泛的功能集。
zh.hook: 通过 Shiki 改变您的笔记记录：一个跟踪每个变化的 TUI 应用，支持独立的 git 仓库。
zh.does: Shiki 是一个基于终端的笔记记录应用，采用三窗格 Yazi 风格导航，允许用户将笔记本管理为独立的 git 仓库。它具有真实的每笔记版本历史、快速模糊搜索和可定制主题。
zh.edge: Shiki 的突出能力是其真实的每笔记版本历史，使用户能够直接从 TUI 浏览和恢复更改，与其他笔记记录应用不同。
zh.why_use: 选择 Shiki 由于其与现有 markdown 文件和 git 工作流的无缝集成，使其成为重视版本控制的笔记记录用户的理想选择。

does: Shiki is a terminal-based note-taking app that uses a three-pane Yazi-style navigation, allowing users to manage notebooks as independent git repositories. It features real per-note version history, fast fuzzy search, and customizable themes.
edge: Shiki's standout capability is its real per-note version history, enabling users to browse and revert changes directly from the TUI, unlike other note-taking apps.
why_use: Choose Shiki for its seamless integration with existing markdown files and git workflows, making it ideal for users who prioritize version control in their note-taking.
hook: Transform your note-taking with Shiki: a TUI app that tracks every change across independent git repos.
